name: substack-edit-about-page
description: Replace a Substack publication's About page with new rich text. The text is read back in the editor before Save. After Save the recipe proves the change twice: from the publication's own JSON (field subscribe_content) and from the public /about page.
requires: Extension build with the paste_html action (Yeshie branch feat/substack-recipes). Run from scripts/substack.mjs, which opens a Substack tab, converts Markdown to HTML and supports --dry-run.
authorship: Mike Wolf (direction); Claude Opus 5 (CCc), 2026-09-15, from that day's survey of aiwtf.substack.com settings.
anomalies: The About page is not a post. Settings > Website > About page > Edit opens /publish/settings/edit?title=About%20page&bodyField=subscribe_content, which edits the publication field subscribe_content. Navigating to that URL directly opens the same editor.
The editor is TipTap ([data-testid='editor']) with an explicit Save button. It sits beside a 'Saved' label, so do not use that label as proof of a save.
Substack's JSON escapes non-ASCII characters as \uXXXX. proof_text must therefore be plain ASCII words that appear in the new text.
s01 refuses to run on a tab that is not on substack.com, so a run never navigates whatever tab happens to be active.

chain.message: This run landed on a tab that is not on substack.com. Open a Substack tab first (scripts/substack.mjs does) and pass its tab id; refusing to navigate whatever tab is active.
Not on the About page editor (signed out, or Substack redirected). Run 01-login first.

chain.note: Let the save request finish before leaving the editor. Leaving too early abandons it.

chain.note: Public proof: the live About page shows the new text.
